_comment: Brokerage accounts the automated pipeline never touches, used as the picklist for the Manual Ledger tab. Copy to accounts.json and edit. Names are free-form labels — nothing matches them against the executor's account IDs.
_sizing: equity + alloc_pct are optional and per account. With both set, picking the account in the Add-entry form auto-fills Qty as floor(equity * alloc_pct / 100 / entry price); typing your own Qty stops it being overwritten. Leave either out (or use the plain-string form) and Qty stays entirely manual — a missing equity is never treated as 0 and a missing alloc_pct is never treated as 100%. alloc_pct is a share of the account, so values above 100 are ignored as typos.
